scope.summary: Carry explicit per-contour path direction + a reverse-direction command that leaves anchor/handle geometry unchanged and governs even-odd/winding hole resolution, arrowhead start/end, and text-on-path start/end; classify anchor continuity C0 (corner) / C1 (mirror-angle) / G2-approximate (corner-smoothed) and forbid silent smooth->corner downgrade so any continuity change is an explicit history-tracked edit.
acceptance_criteria: explicit direction + geometry-preserving reverse; C0/C1/G2 classification; no silent downgrade
expected_tests: test: reverse preserves anchors/handles + flips winding/arrowhead semantics; continuity class computed; no silent downgrade (guard test)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Direction/continuity undefined; holes, arrowheads, and smoothness corrupt on edit.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
